svg.text: The shifting black car · FINAL BOSS — contestant vehicle dossier
“You’ve done so well. You’ve balanced every account but the last one. Shall we?”
The charcoal-suit figure at the wheel
Form shifts: town-car / hearse / armored car
License plate: a different name each time
A featureless jet-black 1950s town car, glossy
void-black paintwork, no markings, uncanny and
pristine, a charcoal-suited figure at the wheel;
the shifting form is done via material and VFX,
Realistic · Symmetry On · Quad · ~60k tris · PBR 4K · the house always wins
